study: Comparative H2S sour-service surface-recession sensitivity study v4.0
warning: Only the 316L paper supplies a near-matching experimental sour-service corrosion-rate point. All other numeric material rates are transparent exploratory inputs, NOT material-specific published rates at these conditions.

6061_T6.label: Al 6061-T6
6061_T6.basis: Hypothetical wet-sour screening; lower scenario near Yang et al. published 0.0881 mm/y for 6061 in H2S GAS at 75C, NOT liquid 60C. Wet exposure cannot be inferred reliably.

7075_T6.label: Al 7075-T6
7075_T6.basis: Uncalibrated wet-sour design sensitivity. Literature comparing 7075-T6 to 6061-T6 finds 7075 more susceptible in chloride exposure; NO matched sour rate reported.

1020_NORMALIZED.label: AISI 1020 normalized
1020_NORMALIZED.basis: Uncalibrated representative carbon-steel sour-service range. Carbon steel H2S literature reports strong dependence on scale, pH, flow and co-gas; no certified normalized 1020 coupon at this exact environment.

AISI_304.label: AISI 304
AISI_304.basis: Hypothetical range anchored only qualitatively by sour-environment comparative 304L/316L research (316L lower rate), not an experiment on 304 at the current 3 bar H2S conditions.

AISI_316.label: AISI 316
AISI_316.basis: Central 0.74 mm/y measured on 316L (different grade) at 60C, 3bar H2S, acidic 5% NaCl. Low/high are illustrative 0.5x/2x sensitivity, not statistical uncertainty.

model.method: Explicit time integration of local constant-rate recession: h_(n+1)=h_n-r_i*delta_t/365, 1 day steps; rates are set by material scenario times common spatial hotspot shape
model.localized_factor_source: AISI 316L published peak pitting-rate 2.4 mm/year divided by 316L uniform 0.74 mm/year = 3.243243 applied as a common worst-case what-if factor, NOT proven for other materials.
model.hotspot_placement: Demonstrative spatial template inherited from earlier chamber mapping; spatial hotspot positions NOT calculated from electrochemistry, flow, or stress.
model.geometry: Full original 10-solid mesh retained; colors/numerical recession, not re-meshed eroded CAD

sources.title: Shah et al (2020), 316L 3 bar H2S vs without H2S
Shah et al (2022) 316L pitting measured in highly sour environment
Davoodi et al 2011 304L versus 316L in H2S acidic electrolyte
Yang et al 2022 6061 gaseous and liquid H2S
Zhang et al AISI-1020 CO2/H2S corrosion at 60C
